sourceDate.text: 少時及魏公子毋忌為客

translationRepairs: Do you think I would cast away my generals because of mere subordinates?"
Do you think I would cling to my generalship?

豈以臣重去將哉 asks whether Chen Yu would regard abandoning the generalship (去將) as weighty; the original invents discarding subordinate generals, while the proposal matches the sense and the following 脫解印綬.
Would you imagine I would discard my generals over mere subordinates?"
Would I take abandoning the generalship as a weighty matter?
The same 去將 means leaving the general's office, not discarding generals; the proposed literal correctly renders 重去將 as taking that resignation as a weighty matter.
"The general said he wanted only the Zhao king."
The general said, "You want only the king."
燕將曰：「若欲得王耳」 has the general addressing the visitor (若 = you) about wanting only the king; the original misquotes narrative attribution and makes the general the one who wants the Zhao king.
